fusions.name: Run-Down
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and strike it, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ground Breaker
fusions.desc: Slams the ground, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Weight of Numbers
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Cornered Fury
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, your damage rises 50% for 8 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
